title: Deeper/broader ACadSharp Prototype_1b reader merge and FreeCAD DWG/3D route refresh
mode: primary-source web research and local implementation-readiness reconciliation
scope: Refresh ACadSharp Prototype_1b/DataStorage reader and PR status after earlier open-proposal snapshots
Recheck LibreDWG AcDs limitations as a peer route
Reconcile current FreeCAD documented DWG conversion and 3D import routes
Convert new evidence into bounded, optional implementation-ready checks

localCodeInspection: src/drw_datastorage.cpp: segmentIndexEntryCount is bounded by segment/section bytes and indexed segments validate headers and ranges
tests/dwg_reader_matrix_tests.cpp: existing generated DataIndex-order and Blob01-chain owners are present; explicit stale-secondary-segidx coverage requires confirmation
method.limitations: The ACadSharp release tag ancestry and v3.7.1 built artifact were not inspected directly; PR discussion corpus results are peer-reported, not reproduced. FreeCAD route documentation is not a platform runtime result. The exact ODA path in AGENTS.md was absent; the available local copy with a '(1)' filename suffix was reviewed (SHA-256 1ed2e02722862188120da606e4b6a816fa4014c96de68da2f84a2ecda09461e7) and §24 was cross-checked against the official public PDF URL.

sources.revision: Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §24, public PDF reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The document specifies the DataStorage segment index, DataIndex rows, object-handle-bearing record headers, direct payload and Blob01-page paths, and notes that schema-search data may be ignored for reading.
sources.limits: The PDF was read from the official online URL because the local AGENTS.md path was unavailable; no downloaded copy or checksum was added to the repository.

sources.revision: PR #1154 merged 2026-07-28; v3.7.1 release tag d7dc111 dated 2026-08-18; release ancestry not directly verified
sources.observed: The merged reader parses the DWG Prototype_1b section using segment/index/data structures and blob pages. PR #1156 was closed after its author reported end-to-end R2013+ entity payload recovery via DataStorage. The PR discussion reports that after a payload-anchor correction, 3,715 referenced payload handles matched by hash across a 423-file corpus; it also records a stale segment-index overflow on an intermediate reader branch.
sources.limits: The corpus results are comments, not independently reproduced. The peer’s release source/runtime was not built, and no external drawing was acquired. Parser coverage does not establish ACIS validity, kernel semantics, writer interoperability, or native CAD acceptance.

sources.revision: Issue #1411 remained open on 2026-10-20 and names LibreDWG 0.14.8593/source 8a1ae764
sources.observed: The issue reports R2013+ ACIS payload loss while entity records survive DWG-to-DXF conversion. The current source route must be evaluated by exact version and full AcDs record/entity association rather than by entity counts or section/signature scanning alone.
sources.limits: The report was not reproduced. Current mutable source presence does not qualify a released conversion path or establish a local libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Mutable main-branch documentation and source pages reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: Stock DWG import converts to DXF and then invokes a selected DXF importer; the current guide identifies CADExchanger separately as the available path for 3D DWG work.
sources.limits: Documentation is not Linux/Windows runtime evidence. Converter, selected importer, output version, entity dispositions, and any separate 3D route must be tested and reported independently.

sources.revision: Open issue report against ACadSharp 3.4.9; later v3.7.1 release exists
sources.observed: The issue reports 3DSOLID/REGION omission in a specific old DXF writer version.
sources.limits: The report does not prove the later release has the same behavior or that it is fixed.

decision.planDelta: Update ACadSharp from an open Prototype_1b proposal to a candidate merged/released structured DWG reader, subject to exact tag/source verification and one optional pinned structural comparison. Keep the LibreDWG issue as version-specific non-oracle evidence. Split FreeCAD stock DWG-to-DXF-to-import qualification from any separate 3D-DWG/CADExchanger workflow. Consider one generated stale-secondary-segidx safety test only if current fast owners do not already exercise it. No local parser defect or support promotion.

implementationReadyChecks: Verify that the exact ACadSharp release source includes merged PR #1154 and inspect the public DataStorage-to-ModelerGeometry payload path before selecting it as a peer.
Pin release/source SHA, runtime, options, input hash, and strict completion result; compare record identity, index, handle, complete pages, payload hash, owner join, and per-object disposition.

If the generated local fast tests lack stale secondary segment-index coverage, add one bounded scratch-generated case only after establishing expected disposition from the authoritative section contract; run only its owning selector and CTest.
For FreeCAD, bind each platform to exact converter executable and selected DXF importer; capture arguments, process diagnostics/return code, output hash/version, and per-source-entity outcome.
Keep stock FreeCAD 2D/explicit-entity acceptance separate from any commercial CADExchanger 3D route, ACIS kernel semantics, and DWG AcDs payload proof.
If any optional peer or platform profile cannot be pinned cheaply, record NOT_QUALIFIED once and self-unblock without adding a dependency, fixture, full-suite gate, or support claim.

validation.commitBlocker: Shared worktree contains extensive user-owned changes; no staging or commit performed.
